title:
Space engineering
Adoption Notice of CCSDS 231.0-B-4, TC Synchronization and Channel Coding
short_title: ECSS Adoption Notice of CCSDS 231.0-B-4 (TC coding)
organisation: ECSS Secretariat, ESA-ESTEC Requirements & Standards Section (prepared by the ECSS Space Communications Working Group)
status_notes: ECSS-E-AS-50-24C Rev.1 of 13 January 2023 is 'First issue, Revision 1' and replaces ECSS-E-AS-50-24C of 1 March 2021; the first issue, together with ECSS-E-AS-50-25C and ECSS-E-AS-50-26C, replaced ECSS-E-ST-50-04C (change log, p. 3). The context clause states that ECSS-E-ST-50-04 is superseded by this notice together with ECSS-E-AS-50-25 and ECSS-E-AS-50-26 (latest versions) (p. 6). Whether a later revision exists is not stated in the document.

key_points.text: Requirement ECSS-E-AS-50-24_1550001 makes CCSDS 231.0-B-4, TC Synchronization and Channel Coding, Issue 4, July 2021 applicable with the modifications of Table 4-1.
CCSDS 231.0-B-4 corresponds to clauses 8 (Synchronization and coding sublayer) and 9 (Physical layer) of ECSS-E-ST-50-04.

Modified Note 2 to the Transfer Frame definition: the service data unit of the Coding & Synchronization sublayer is one TC Transfer Frame or a single USLP Transfer Frame (CCSDS allows one or more TC frames); Annex A3 of CCSDS is changed in the same way.
Clause 2.2.2 is changed so that the modified BCH code is decoded in error-correcting mode and the FECF is used to reduce the probability of undetected errors.

Randomization is not optional for either BCH or LDPC: clauses 2.2.4, 3.4.3, Note 2 of 5.2.3, Table 5-1 and 6.1 are modified, Note 2 of 6.3.1 is deleted, and the Table 8-2 Randomizer row allows only 'Used'.
Clause 3.5 is modified: BCH codewords shall be decoded in Single Error Correction (SEC) mode, correcting one bit and detecting two; the Triple Error Detection (TED) option is deleted.
With BCH coding, the search for the Start Sequence in State 2 accepts a Start Sequence containing one error; Table 8-2 allows only 'Error-Correcting' decoding and '1' error in the Start Sequence.
Clause 7.2.2 is modified: the Acquisition Sequence minimum length shall be 16 octets (CCSDS: preferred minimum), with alternating ones and zeros.
Clause 7.2.4 is modified: the Idle Sequence shall be at least 8 bits long; its maximum length is unconstrained.

Clause 7.5.2 is modified: with PLOP-2 a minimum Idle Sequence of one octet shall be inserted between each CLTU, to prevent a lockout when a CLTU start pattern is missed and a false start pattern spans the last BCH codeword and the Tail Sequence.

Annex A: CCSDS 231.0-B-4 adds LDPC coding (ECSS-E-ST-50-04 had only the modified BCH code), normative managed parameters (formerly informative Annex E), formal service interfaces and the optional Repetitions parameter for CLTU transfer.
ECSS-E-ST-50-04 Annex D (frame rejection and undetected error rates) has no equivalent in CCSDS 231.0-B-4; similar data is in CCSDS 230.1-G-3. CCSDS 231.0-B-4 supports both TC SDLP and USLP frames.

notes: Adoption notices contain no normative-references clause; the adopted CCSDS 231.0-B-4 is listed as 'normative' because requirement ECSS-E-AS-50-24_1550001 makes it applicable (p. 8). The context clause says the coding schemes are 'for use with CCSDS 231.0-B-4, TC Space Data Link Protocol' (p. 6), a typo for CCSDS 232.0-B-4. The change log cites 'Note 2 to Transfer Frame definition in 1.6.1.2' (p. 3) while Table 4-1 says 1.6.1.3 (p. 8). Annex A.2.6 prints 'CSDS 231.0-B-4' (p. 18). Table 4-1 cells are extracted with interleaved columns (pp. 10, 12, 14). The bibliography lists the TM coding notice at Rev.1 (CCSDS 131.0-B-4); the library holds the newer ECSS-E-AS-50-21C Rev. 2 (CCSDS 131.0-B-5). The superseded ECSS-E-ST-50-04C is in the library as ecss-e-st-50-04c31july2008 and CCSDS 231.0-B-4 as ccsds-231-0-231x0b4e1 (with a later corrigendum copy, ccsds-231-0-231x0b4e1c1). Printed page numbers equal PDF page numbers; srcgrep shows 20 PDF pages (the last one blank) while the registry gives 19.
